fusions.name: Blood Scent Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunging bite that deals 9 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. It deals more the more afflictions the target carries, up to 40% more. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Maw Snap
fusions.desc: A snapping cone deals 26 damage to everything in it, ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Circling Hunger
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. While it lasts, an escort of reef sharks fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 5 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wounded Wake
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 15% against any enemy below 40% health.
